selection_policy: Hand-selected development pilot after event splits were fixed; selection records original contiguous turns and speaker/context review. No model outputs or test scores were used to tune selection. Source text remains local; tracked records use bounded exact excerpts.
source_hash_definition: TED publisher_caption_sha256 from tools.transcripts.ted. Lex SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON array of {id,speaker,text,start}, sorted keys and compact separators; HTML file hashes can vary independently.
